success_criteria: The exact no-argument verifier preserves the checked-in Next config byte for byte and rejects workspace source aliases.
The task-5 receipt records the preserved config hash and all packed production/browser gates pass.
The scoped realtime manager is recreated when the provider store changes.
The example unregisters the prior adapter when its manager changes and preserves running intent across recreation.
A runtime regression proves events write only to the replacement provider graph.
Coverage, exports, docs, Changesets, OpenSpec, release policy, and evidence hashes agree while React rc.1 remains independent.
